review.title: PES N7/A11 genus-reference correspondences: scoped M5 diagnostic
review.independence_basis: Parent independently inspected the retained primary Section 3.1 anchors, exact stock notes, native route report, authored source config and candidate hashes before application. The shared binder, writer, check runner and diagnostic builder received separate read-only reviews and meaningful controls. This authored technical assessment is self-review of the resulting bounded correction.
review.summary: The unchanged Pelagerythrobacter N7 and Salinicola A11 genus identities now carry their native GTDB genus-reference correspondences, with filtered reference populations 16/16 and 46/46. These are database correspondences for the declared genera, not exact species or assembly placements of the study stocks. The actual M5 application preserved all other scientific content and prior history, appended native provenance, and passed eight scoped commands.
review.scope_description: Two declared taxonomy genus-reference blocks, statuses, exact source/authority bindings and actual provenance in one PES record. Existing experimental, ecological and mechanism assertions are preserved without new full scientific clearance.
review.selection: One whole record, CommunityMech:000340, selected as the first community record using the shared higher-rank source-binding/application/check/review path. Prior isolated N7 and A11 canaries are separate evidence; the prepared three-record group has not been canonically applied.
limitations: Partial technical and provenance assessment with scientific_review:false. It does not complete a full scientific record review, the outstanding taxonomy repair campaign or corpus QC.

The native 16/16 and 46/46 denominators count named-binomial reference genomes retained by the exact 761d5537 crosswalk algorithm at genus rank. They do not count study stocks or establish that N7 or A11 is represented by an assembly in the crosswalk.

The primary genus/stock anchors and local NCBI label/rank evidence were inspected; no new complete paper, supplement, figure, sequence or assembly audit was performed. The local NCBI database was stat-bound, not fully hash-certified or assigned a release.

Primary/source binding and private candidate staging used local Python 3.13.12; actual guarded application and the eight commands used M5 Python 3.13.2 at the same 23d84a2d code revision. The earlier native route report explicitly retains its 52c740b6 execution revision. No clean-tree claim is made for gates after the approved canonical application.

The mapping_source date records the mapping file's mtime only, not a GTDB or NCBI release. Native is_reclassified:false compares current genus names and does not independently reconstruct nomenclatural history.

The hphtC-5 enzyme assignment, intermember intermediate transfer, emulsifier contribution and reciprocal fitness remain qualified/open. Pyrene removal remains distinct from carbon mineralization; no biological assertion or prior scientific decision was changed.

Native term validation reported Validation passed without an assertion denominator. Source-snippet matching, affected-page generation, strict historical successor admission and final combined QC are separate work, not implied by these eight successful commands.
